title: Sanju Samson Breaks Dhoni's CSK Wicketkeeper Record in Milestone IPL 2026 Season
excerpt: The Kerala-born keeper-batter surpassed Dhoni's decade-old single-season runs mark, adding another chapter to CSK's storied legacy
body:
Sanju Samson has surpassed MS Dhoni's long-standing record for the most runs scored by a CSK wicketkeeper-batter in a single IPL season, crossing the 477-run mark during Chennai's clash against Sunrisers Hyderabad at MA Chidambaram Stadium. Dhoni's benchmark of 461 runs, set during his iconic 2013 campaign, had stood for over a decade.

## Context & Background

Samson's journey to Chennai has been one of the more intriguing sub-plots of IPL 2026. After spending the bulk of his career with Rajasthan Royals — where he served as captain from 2021 to 2024 — the Kerala-born wicketkeeper joined CSK ahead of this season. The move invited inevitable comparisons with Dhoni, the franchise's greatest icon and the man who redefined what a wicketkeeper-batter could achieve in T20 cricket.

Across 14 IPL seasons, Samson has now accumulated over 5,100 career runs at a strike rate north of 140, making him one of the tournament's all-time leading run-scorers. His five IPL centuries — including a memorable knock against Mumbai Indians earlier this season — place him alongside Kohli and de Villiers in the franchise's record books, though his consistency across different roles and teams is perhaps his most underrated quality.

Dhoni's 2013 record was built during CSK's dominant era, when the veteran captain anchored innings with his trademark finishing ability. Samson's approach has been markedly different — more aggressive, more willing to take risks at the top and middle order, yet equally effective in reading match situations.

## Current Developments

The record fell during CSK's league-stage encounter against SRH on May 18, a match with significant playoff implications for both sides. Samson's contribution — measured, composed, and punctuated by trademark wristwork through the off-side — underlined why CSK's management invested in him as their long-term wicketkeeper option.

CSK currently sit sixth in the standings with 12 points from 12 matches. With the playoff race entering its final week, every run from Samson's bat carries added weight. His form has been the team's most consistent bright spot in a season of mixed results, and the franchise's long-term leadership planning reportedly factors in Samson's growing influence in the dressing room.

The broader IPL 2026 standings paint a picture of fierce competition: Royal Challengers Bengaluru lead with 18 points, Gujarat Titans are second on 16, and the battle for the remaining two playoff spots involves six teams separated by just seven points.

## Diaspora Impact

For Kerala's sprawling global diaspora — one of India's most geographically dispersed communities, with significant populations across the Gulf states, the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom — Samson's milestone carries particular resonance. Unlike many Indian cricket stars who hail from major metros, Samson grew up in Thiruvananthapuram's modest cricketing infrastructure before making it to the biggest stage.

NRI fans following the IPL through streaming platforms like JioCinema and Willow TV have watched Samson's evolution from a talented but inconsistent prospect to a mature, match-winning presence. His move to CSK — a franchise with perhaps the most passionate and organised fan base among overseas Indians — amplified his visibility significantly.

Social media reactions from diaspora communities reflected both pride in Samson's achievement and nostalgia for Dhoni's era, with many noting the symbolic passing of the gloves at CSK.

## What's Next

CSK's remaining league fixtures will determine whether Samson's record-breaking season translates into a playoff berth. The team needs results in their favour alongside strong individual performances. For Samson personally, the next milestone is within reach: surpassing 5,200 career IPL runs would further cement his standing among the tournament's all-time greats.

The bigger question surrounds his international career. Samson's IPL form has consistently outpaced his India selection, and another dominant season may force selectors to reconsider his place in the T20I setup ahead of future ICC events.
